_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: playlists
constraints: CHECK ((kind = 'mix' AND mix_plugin_id IS NOT NULL AND mix_seed_source_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'mix' AND mix_plugin_id IS NULL AND mix_seed_source_id IS NULL AND mix_seed_cid IS NULL))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "appearance_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "theme_mode" TEXT NULL, "locale" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "network_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "cache_limit_mb" INTEGER NULL, "radio_status_interval_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "chart_refresh_interval_minutes" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playback_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "audio_quality" TEXT NULL, "audio_format_priority" TEXT NULL, "remember_position" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("remember_position" IN (0, 1)), "temp_play_rewind_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "skip_preview_clips" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("skip_preview_clips" IN (0, 1)), "output_device_id" TEXT NULL, "output_device_name" TEXT NULL, "restart_rewind_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "play_history_limit" INTEGER NULL, "auto_scroll_to_current" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("auto_scroll_to_current" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installed_plugins" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "manifest_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "script" TEXT NOT NULL, "installed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "source_index_url" TEXT NULL, "checks_json" TEXT NULL, "from_dev_folder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("from_dev_folder" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plugin_indexes" ("url" TEXT NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("url"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plugin_storage" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES installed_plugins (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tracks" ("track_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cid" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "uploader" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "artwork_json" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "part_index" INTEGER NULL, "parent_title" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "queue_entries" ("position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_key" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (track_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "shuffle_rank" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "player_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "current_position" INTEGER NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "loop_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "shuffle_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("shuffle_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "volume" REAL NOT NULL, "muted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("muted" IN (0, 1)), "mode" TEXT NULL, "mix_plugin_id" TEXT NULL, "mix_id" TEXT NULL, "mix_title" TEXT NULL, "mix_cursor" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "play_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "track_key" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (track_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "layout_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "player_tab" TEXT NULL, "panel_expanded" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("panel_expanded" IN (0, 1)), "panel_width" REAL NULL CHECK("panel_width" <= 1600.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_json" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_in_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_refresh_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_refresh_result" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_settings" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "browse_as_logged_in" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("browse_as_logged_in" IN (0, 1)), "match_target" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("match_target" IN (0, 1)), "match_rank" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "developer_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "developer_mode" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("developer_mode" IN (0, 1)), "log_level" TEXT NULL, "plugin_dev_folder" TEXT NULL, "report_reminder_dismissed" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("report_reminder_dismissed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduler_runs" ("job_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("job_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "radio_stations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "host_name" TEXT NULL, "artwork_json" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "live_status" TEXT NULL, "live_title" TEXT NULL, "status_checked_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("plugin_id", "room_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "artwork_json" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mix_plugin_id" TEXT NULL, "mix_seed_source_id" TEXT NULL, "mix_seed_cid" INTEGER NULL, CHECK ((kind = 'mix' AND mix_plugin_id IS NOT NULL AND mix_seed_source_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind <> 'mix' AND mix_plugin_id IS NULL AND mix_seed_source_id IS NULL AND mix_seed_cid IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_key" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (track_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "remote_item_id" TEXT NULL, "unavailable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unavailable" IN (0, 1)), "seen_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playlist_remote" ("playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_name" TEXT NULL, "writable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("writable" IN (0, 1)), "name_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("name_overridden" IN (0, 1)), "description_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("description_overridden" IN (0, 1)), "artwork_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("artwork_overridden" IN (0, 1)), "refresh_interval_hours" INTEGER NULL, "last_refreshed_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_result" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "refresh_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("playlist_id"), UNIQUE ("plugin_id", "remote_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chart_settings" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id", "chart_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_results" ("origin_plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "artists" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "selected_track_key" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tracks (track_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "score" REAL NULL, "user_selected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("user_selected" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("origin_plugin_id", "origin_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_origins" ("track_key" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tracks (track_key) ON DELETE CASCADE, "origin_plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("track_key", "origin_plugin_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_imports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "legacy_schema_version" INTEGER NULL, "backup_version" INTEGER NULL, "summary_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "acknowledged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("acknowledged" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_playlist_ids" ("legacy_import_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES legacy_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "legacy_playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "playlist_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES playlists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("legacy_import_id", "legacy_playlist_id"));
CREATE INDEX queue_entries_track_key ON queue_entries (track_key)
CREATE INDEX play_history_played_at ON play_history (played_at)
CREATE INDEX play_history_track_key ON play_history (track_key)
CREATE INDEX playlist_entries_playlist ON playlist_entries (playlist_id, position)
CREATE INDEX playlist_entries_track_key ON playlist_entries (track_key)
CREATE INDEX match_results_selected ON match_results (selected_track_key)
